Food and behaviour both are wow with reasonable pricing.
Feb 2024 • Solo
Grab a dish of chicken pakoda. It just melts in my mouth since it is so soft. Due to an unpleasant morning encounter, I skipped lunch. However, after eating the pakoda, the waiter—the lady owner's son—told me not to buy a half since it would be too heavy for me, so I got a quarter of chicken tandoor and a Saigon beer instead. Wow, that's even better. It only need to marinate longer. I therefore have a pretty great meal that doubles as snacks. Because of the owners' kind demeanor, I plan to return.

Good Hospitality and Good Food
Dec 2023 • Couples
While searching for an Indian Restaurant in the vicinity, we ended up at this restaurant. We were pleasantly surprised to enter and hear Hindi from this smiling Vietnamese lady - Ms Shofia. The food was tasty and cost friendly compared to other places we tried in Ho Chi Min City. The lady was friendly and in the conversation she told me that she used to work for an Indian Restaurant for 17 years and then opened up her own restaurant. She has never been to India but still speaks fluent Hindi. The place is definitely worth visiting.
